note: Christmas Island: residence as a non-citizen is Australia's (its visas and their terms), since the Migration Act 1958 extends to the territory and deems it part of Australia for the Act's purposes (section 7). Read in the Act's compilation 172 (in force 8 October 2026) on the Federal Register of Legislation on 2026-10-30.

sources.title: Migration Act 1958 (compilation 172), section 7
sources.said: 7 Act to extend to certain Territories (1) In this section, prescribed Territory means Norfolk Island, the Coral Sea Islands Territory, the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands, the Territory of Christmas Island and the Territory of Ashmore and Cartier Islands. (2) This Act extends to a prescribed Territory. (3) Subject to this Act, a prescribed Territory: (a) shall be deemed to be part of Australia for the purposes of this Act
